title: 第17章 都统大人第18章 结阵冲阵
slug: 骂我朝廷鹰犬我乃大秦武圣
content_zh:
穿着赤鳞军都统战甲而归的，不是赤鳞军都统余林，而是被赤鳞军征召的武卫张远。
赵长明见过张远，是在救治陶公子时候，顺手将自己的长刀送给昏睡的张远。
“怎么会这样，怎么会这样……”
赵长明面色苍白，脚步往后退几步，差点被门槛绊倒。
回来的如果是余林，哪怕身受重伤，凭着一人斩三先天的强横，也能震慑燕军，更能提振秦军士气，让他们守城军卒全力拼杀。
可回来的是张远。
那都统余林定然是陨落在城外。
也就是说，如今城中实际战力，只剩他赵长明一位先天境，加上不足五百残卒。
“都统大人他，他——”赵长明抬头，紧盯张远。
哪怕知道答案，赵长明也要张远亲口说出来。
“都统大人以一敌三，与敌拼杀到最后一刻。”张远轻声开口。
“他让我转告赵副都统，丰田县城，不用守了。”
轻吸一口气，张远看向院外云涛：“其实两个月前就不用守了。”
赵长明浑身一颤，看着张远，轻轻点头。
“不错，死守丰田县城这件事，只有我和都统大人知道。”
身为余林的副手，同是先天境高手，余林的决定自然需要赵长明的支持。
看着面前穿戴赤鳞战甲，面容刚毅的张远，赵长明轻叹一声：“张远，多谢你回来报讯。”
“我安排城中剩下的守军突围，到时候你就在我身边，我会带你离开。”
张远假扮余林拼死归来报信，给了赵长明选择的机会，同时也让本跌落到谷底的士气不至于崩塌。
若不然，刚才城池可能就已经守不住了。

“张远，你先休整，”看着张远，赵长明沉声道：“除了我，你见任何人都不要露真容。”
“这很重要，如果知道都统大人陨落，我怕军卒再无战意，连突围都无一战之心。”
在赵长明看来，张远不过是个十六七岁少年，很多事情并不能真正明白。
但张远拼死归来，有些事情他需要跟张远说清楚。
“卑职明白。”张远点头，“在其他人面前，我就是都统大人。”
听到张远回答，赵长明轻舒一口气，转身往外走，到门口处，将院门关上离开。
张远看着赵长明离开，院门关上，方才浑身一软，坐到廊檐边石阶。
呆坐片刻，脑海中今日从出城到归来所有画面走马灯一般浮现。
手掌用力握住刀柄，超过一千五百斤的力量让他浑身瞬间绑紧。
一道金色光幕在脑海深处浮现。
【张远】
身份：大秦庐阳府九品皂衣卫，赤鳞军征召战卒
修为：后天境后期，修为未稳固，无法升级
content_en:
The person who returned wearing the Red Scale Army Commander's battle armor was not the Red Scale Army Commander Yu Lin, but Zhang Yuan, the military guard recruited by the Red Scale Army.
Zhao Changming met Zhang Yuan. When he was treating Mr. Tao, he gave his long knife to the sleeping Zhang Yuan.
"How could this happen? How could this happen..."
Zhao Changming looked pale and took a few steps back, almost tripping over the threshold.
If it was Yu Lin who came back, even if he was seriously injured, with his innate tyranny of killing three by one person, he would be able to frighten the Yan army and boost the morale of the Qin army, allowing their defenders to fight with all their might.
But it was Zhang Yuan who came back.
That Dutong Yulin must have died outside the city.
In other words, the only actual combat strength left in the city now is Zhao Changming, a Xiantian realm warrior, and less than five hundred remaining soldiers.
"Lord Dutong, he, he—" Zhao Changming raised his head and stared at Zhang Yuan.
Even if he knew the answer, Zhao Changming still wanted Zhang Yuan to tell it himself.
"Lord Dutong, one against three, fight with the enemy until the last moment." Zhang Yuan spoke softly.
"He asked me to tell Vice Governor Zhao that Toyota County's seat no longer needs to be guarded."
Taking a breath, Zhang Yuan looked at Yuntao outside the hospital: "Actually, I stopped guarding him two months ago."
Zhao Changming trembled, looked at Zhang Yuan, and nodded gently.
"Yes, only Mr. Tutong and I know about the matter of defending Toyota County."
As Yu Lin's deputy and also a master of the Xiantian realm, Yu Lin's decision naturally requires the support of Zhao Changming.
Looking at Zhang Yuan in front of him who was wearing red scale armor and had a resolute face, Zhao Changming sighed softly: "Zhang Yuan, thank you for coming back to report the news."
"I will arrange for the remaining defenders in the city to break out. When the time comes, you will be by my side and I will take you away."
Zhang Yuan pretended to be Yu Lin and returned desperately to report the news, which gave Zhao Changming a chance to choose, and at the same time prevented his morale from collapsing when it had hit rock bottom.
Otherwise, the city might not have been able to be defended just now.
"Zhang Yuan, you need to rest first." Looking at Zhang Yuan, Zhao Changming said solemnly: "Except for me, don't show your true face to anyone."
"This is very important. If I know that Lord Dutong has died, I'm afraid that the soldiers will no longer have the will to fight, and they won't even have the heart to fight to break out of the encirclement."
In Zhao Changming's view, Zhang Yuan is just a sixteen or seventeen-year-old boy who does not really understand many things.
But Zhang Yuan returned desperately, and there were some things he needed to explain clearly to Zhang Yuan.
"I understand the humble position." Zhang Yuan nodded, "In front of other people, I am Lord Dutong."
Hearing Zhang Yuan's answer, Zhao Changming breathed a sigh of relief, turned around and walked out, went to the door, closed the door and left.
Zhang Yuan watched Zhao Changming leave and the courtyard door closed, then he felt weak and sat down on the stone steps beside the eaves.
After sitting for a moment, all the images from leaving the city to returning home appeared in my mind like a revolving door.
He firmly grasped the handle of the knife with his palms, and the force of more than 1,500 kilograms made his whole body tighten instantly.
A golden light curtain emerged in the back of my mind.
【Zhang Yuan】
Identity: Ninth-grade Zaoyi Guard in Luyang Mansion of the Great Qin Dynasty, a soldier recruited by the Red Scale Army
Cultivation: In the late stage of Houtian realm, the cultivation is not stable and cannot be upgraded.
